title: Where the missing socks live

blocks.text: I found where all your missing socks live.
Every wash, one sock vanishes. You keep the lonely one for months, just in case.
SockLock has a tiny magnet in the cuff. The pair snaps together and stays together through wash and dry.
Customers say the pairs finally stay together.
Try 5 pairs for $29, delivered every quarter.
